name: FLUX 3 Studio
description: Klein and Base, editing, LoRA library and Qwen prompt helper

paragraphs: The default encoder is Sakura text encoder, the complete BF16 Qwen3-VL-4B checkpoint from webmp3/Sakura-FLUX.3-Image-Klein-TextEncoder-Uncensored-GGUF, pinned to revision fe49271a47b61efe0d96b476306c25934d943472. It replaces the shared text/vision encoder for both Klein and Klein Base. The official FLUX.3 image transformers, VAE, processor, and all editing and LoRA controls are retained. Exported generation and steering metadata identify the encoder used.

The author's "uncensored" label refers to the modified language encoder, not the FLUX.3 image transformer. It does not establish removal of restrictions in generated images. The encoder's 713 tensor names, shapes and dtypes match the official Qwen3-VL encoder, including its complete vision stack; startup rejects an incomplete or incompatible checkpoint instead of silently using random weights. Initial startup downloads the 8.27 GiB encoder once into the HF cache.

For rollback, set the Space variable FLUX3TEXTENCODER=official and restart. The default is sakura. Both use the official Base text-encoder config and processor pinned to 3f7fa5ee22ca1d5a5cc095ac7cc96e6a173b4c86. The modified encoder is provided by webmp3 under Apache-2.0; see its repository's LICENSE and NOTICE. The FLUX image models retain their FLUX Kommunity License.
